name: Arshoghni Vati

sections.introduction: Arshoghni Vati is an ayurvedic formulation that consists of various herbs in its formulation. It helps maintain healthy digestive fire, supports liver function, and is effective in managing piles (arsha).
sections.ingredients:
Shuddha Rasaunta – Aqueous extract of Berberis aristata 
 Khunakharaba – Exudate 
 Bakayan tree fruits 
 Nimba – Neem – Azadirachta indica’s Fruit 
 Trinakanta Pishti – Kaherva pishti 

 Method of Preparation 

 Take all the ingredients in appropriate quantities. Neem, bakayan tree’s fruits, and Khunakharaba up to 24 grams, Trinakanta Pishti up to 12 grams and Shuddha Rasaunta up to 72 grams. 
 Take neem and bakayan tree fruits and make fine powder. 
 At last add other ingredients also. 
 Prepare the pills by taking the volume up to 250 grams.
sections.dose: One pill three times a day with buttermilk or cold water.
sections.indications:
Bleeding piles 
 Non-bleeding piles 
 To decrease piles mass size
sections.contraindications:
Take under medical prescription especially if suffering from diabetes and hypertension. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Arshoghni Vati 
 Reference – Ayurveda Sara Sangraha, 17th edition, page no. – 413. 
 Introduction 
 Arshoghni Vati is an ayurvedic formulation that consists of various herbs in its formulation. It helps maintain healthy digestive fire, supports liver function, and is effective in managing piles (arsha). 
 Ingredients 
 
 Shuddha Rasaunta – Aqueous extract of Berberis aristata 
 Khunakharaba – Exudate 
 Bakayan tree fruits 
 Nimba – Neem – Azadirachta indica’s Fruit 
 Trinakanta Pishti – Kaherva pishti 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take all the ingredients in appropriate quantities. Neem, bakayan tree’s fruits, and Khunakharaba up to 24 grams, Trinakanta Pishti up to 12 grams and Shuddha Rasaunta up to 72 grams. 
 Take neem and bakayan tree fruits and make fine powder. 
 At last add other ingredients also. 
 Prepare the pills by taking the volume up to 250 grams. 
 
 Dose 
 One pill three times a day with buttermilk or cold water. 
 Indications 
 
 Bleeding piles 
 Non-bleeding piles 
 To decrease piles mass size 
 
 Contraindications 
 Take under medical prescription especially if suffering from diabetes and hypertension. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
